name: SMRT
recent: SMRT Holdings 已于2026年10月20日从 ACE Market 转至 Bursa Malaysia Main Market 上市，股票简称与代码不变。公司发布2026年报，并将在12月4日召开第22届常年股东大会。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比下滑7.4%，净利同比减少36.2%。
notable: 公司于2026年10月20日从 ACE Market 转板至 Bursa Malaysia Main Market 上市。
公司发布2026年报，并发出第22届常年股东大会通知，会议定于2026年12月4日举行。
股东通函涉及续新及新增经常性关联交易股东授权。
risks: 董事在闭门期前表示有意进行证券交易。
最新季度营收与净利同比均下滑。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 12,531,000，同比下滑7.4%，环比增长2.8%；净利为 MYR 4,090,000，同比减少36.2%，环比微增0.6%；净利率为32.6%，低于上一季度的33.3%。

recent_en: SMRT Holdings transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 20 October 2026, with stock short name and code unchanged. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 7.4% year-on-year and net profit declined 36.2% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 20 October 2026.
The company released its 2026 annual report and issued the notice for its 22nd Annual General Meeting to be held on 4 December 2026.
The circular covers the renewal and new shareholders' mandates for recurrent related party transactions.
risks_en: Directors indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
Latest quarterly revenue and net profit both declined year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 12,531,000, down 7.4% year-on-year and up 2.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 4,090,000, down 36.2% year-on-year and up 0.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 32.6%, lower than 33.3% in the previous quarter.
